name: Shipment History
summary: Shipment history lookup, recent shipment browsing, completed-only archived edit/delete actions, read-only modal-window detail review, archived-row drill-in, and user-friendly shipment status labeling for previously recorded Volvo shipments.

userActions: Find and review a shipment history record
Filter shipment history by user-friendly status labels
Open archived shipment rows in the history edit dialog
Delete completed archived shipments from history
validationHints: Confirm shipment history and recent shipment queries still return the expected records
Confirm repeated history reloads replace the bound shipment collection without leaving stale rows selected
Confirm raw stored values such as pending_po render as friendly labels in both the history grid and the shipment detail window
Confirm the history status filter accepts the new Pending PO Number label while still matching the existing stored status values
Confirm View Details opens the dedicated modal window and renders archived lines using the same card treatment as shipment entry
Confirm the History page Edit action is only enabled for completed archived rows and still opens history-table rows in read-only mode
Confirm the Delete button and Delete key are only enabled for completed archived rows and remove the selected history item from the results list after a successful delete
